name: frontend-template
description: Minimal Bun + TypeScript + React template for web projects

scripts.build:pages: bun build frontend.tsx --outdir dist/ --target browser && cp pages.html dist/index.html
scripts.checks: bun run format && (bun run tsc & J1=$!; bun run biome & J2=$!; bun run knip & J3=$!; wait $J1 && wait $J2 && wait $J3)
